mean_cn: n.地毯；（树叶、植物等的）一层；  v.铺以地毯
mean_en: a thick woven material made of wool, etc. for covering floors or stairs; a piece of carpet used as a floor covering, especially when shaped to fit a room; a thick layer of something on the ground
sentence: I put my books on the carpet.
sentence_trans: 我把我的书放在了地毯上。
